question: ______ diseases last for only shorter periods of time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Acute**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Acute diseases**

 
 
• Some diseases last for only very **short periods of time,** and these are called **acute diseases.**
 
• These diseases occur suddenly and last for a shorter time period.
 
• Acute disease causes **sudden damage to the body.**
 
• **Examples** of some Acute diseases are **Typhoid, bone fracture, heart attack, cholera, common cold, jaundice, malaria, etc.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Diseases are mainly two types **based on the duration** of time which are **Acute and chronic diseases.**
 
• **Chronic diseases**
 
 
• The diseases that occur over a period of time and last a **longer duration of time**, or even for a lifetime are called **chronic diseases**.
 
• These diseases progress gradually and usually end up causing long-term damage to organs and internal systems. sometimes chronic diseases become fatal and cause **loss of life.**
 
• Examples of Chronic diseases are **Diabetes, cancer, tuberculosis, arthritis, etc.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Genetic or hereditary diseases**

 
 
• A hereditary disease is often described as something that **“runs in the family.”**
 
• It is passed down from one or both **parents to a child,** who may then pass it to his or her children.
 
• Examples of hereditary disorders are: **Thalassemia, Haemophilia, Sickle-cell anaemia**
